webster.text: The act of violating faith, a promise, vow or allegiance; treachery; the violation of a trust reposed.

example.quote: By this perfidy wives are separated from their husbands, children from their parents, the aged and the sick from their relations and friends, who wish to attend and comfort them; and those who have been used to live in plenty and even elegance, are reduced to deplorable distress.
example.cite: Declaration of the Causes and Necessity of Taking Up Arms, July 6, 1775
